versions.title: 3D blocking v2 · FPV flythrough — six national projects
versions.note: v2: one smooth FPV spline with continuous speed and banking driven by the turns (no jerks). Buildings remodelled from the client photos — KFSH stone & angled glass bays + mosque and minaret, PNU two-level arcades + ribbed dome, the real Talgo duck-bill nose with green & gold swooshes on a viaduct through the station, CST splayed glass towers + silver core + geodesic sphere + lattice canopy with the Riyadh skyline behind, solar field + turbines on a ridge, silos with elevator tower and conveyor. — superseded by v3 (too fast: 1.6 km in 8 s).

versions.title: 3D blocking v3 · calm flythrough — six projects in one compact district
versions.note: v3: the six projects regrouped into one compact district along a single 400 m boulevard (v2 covered 1.6 km in 8 s). Projects alternate sides and sit ahead of the camera so it sees them without whipping round: hospital left, university right, the Talgo pulls out of the station and runs alongside on the viaduct, CST tower right with the skyline behind, solar & turbines left, then the camera rises over the line toward the silos. Steady ~50 m/s, look turns capped (avg 17°/s), bank ≤ 8°, calmer 55° lens. — superseded by v4 (projects too small, at the frame edges).

versions.title: 3D blocking v4 · each project framed for what it is
versions.note: v4: camera keyframed on each project instead of a straight pass. Train: we fly ahead of the Talgo looking back at the nose, it catches up and passes, we lift over the line behind it. Buildings: camera holds on each one close so it fills the frame — hospital, then the university's arcade and dome. Silos: close pass along the row, then the camera rises over them to reveal the solar field and the turbines behind. Finale: the CST tower stands at the end of the railway line, centred with its spire as the train arrives. The look sweeps one way (back → left → forward) so there's no back-and-forth whip.
